method: Neighbour/layout analysis in ghidra/exports/cataclysm_gog_r2a: MSVC keeps per-object function order, so unnamed functions between round-1 anchors are matched to the HW1 source file in source order; each candidate's decompiled body compared with the HW1 function (move-type constants, function-pointer triples written to AITeamMove+0x154/0x158/0x15c, callees, string literals). Identical-code folding (/OPT:ICF) is noted where one body serves several HW1 functions; LAB_ targets are proposed as function entries and flagged as such.
